claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: AC-55649 is a highly lipophilic, poorly soluble RARbeta2-selective agonist that at 2.5 uM likely causes non-specific cytotoxicity through physicochemical membrane/lysosomal stress rather than selective RAR-mediated killing.
